qualifier: resolvins, protectins and maresins from DHA, DPA and EPA
name: Resolvin, protectin and maresin biosynthesis
rationale: All members synthesize docosanoid/EPA-derived pro-resolving mediators (resolvins, protectins, maresins), unlike confusables built on arachidonate-derived lipoxins, HETEs and leukotrienes.

qualifier: FGFR fusions and amplifications
name: Oncogenic RTK signaling by FGFR fusions and amplifications
rationale: Members are cancer-driving RTK alterations dominated by FGFR1/2/3 fusions, amplifications and translocations (plus membrane PDGFR fusions, ALK, LTK), distinguishing them from EGFR/ERBB2 point mutants, cytosolic fusions and ALK resistance mutants.

qualifier: with mRNA stabilization and translation
name: Stress granule dynamics and mRNA stabilization
rationale: Members cover stress granule assembly, localization and disassembly (PKR, arsenite, PML bodies) together with IGF2BP/CRD-mediated mRNA stabilization, whereas confusables centre on ARE-mediated mRNA decay and destabilization.

qualifier: excision, mismatch and translesion repair plus nucleobase editing
name: Excision, mismatch and translesion repair and base editing
rationale: Members span BER, NER, MMR, translesion synthesis, direct damage reversal and deaminase-driven editing/demethylation (including somatic hypermutation), while the confusables are double-strand break repair, homologous recombination and NHEJ.

core: Negative regulation of alpha-beta T cell responses
qualifier: CD4/CD8 activation, proliferation and IFN-gamma production
name: Suppression of alpha-beta T cell activation and IFN-gamma production
rationale: All three members inhibit CD4/CD8 alpha-beta T cell activation or proliferation and type II interferon output, unlike confusables about other cytokines, positive T cell regulation or Th/Treg differentiation.

qualifier: lens, anterior segment, RPE and retinal vascular barrier
name: Eye morphogenesis and retinal vascular barrier formation
rationale: Members build the eye's lens, cornea, iris, RPE, optic cup/nerve and retinal/hyaloid vasculature and blood-retina barrier, whereas confusables concern photoreceptor/retinal neuron differentiation and phototransduction.

qualifier: alpha-2 adrenergic receptors via Gi/Gz
name: Alpha-2 adrenergic Gi/Gz inhibition of adenylate cyclase
rationale: All members describe alpha-2 adrenergic receptor coupling through Gi/Gz to adenylate cyclase inhibition, distinguishing them from catecholamine secretion, cAMP turnover and muscarinic/serotonin receptor themes.

qualifier: cascade activation, recovery and light detection
name: Phototransduction cascade activation, recovery and light detection
rationale: Members cover opsin-triggered phototransduction activation, its inactivation/recovery and light detection, unlike confusables on the retinoid cycle, photoreceptor development or cone opsin defects.

qualifier: with TGF-beta receptor/SMAD cancer mutants
name: Mismatch repair and TGF-beta/SMAD mutants in cancer
rationale: Members combine mismatch repair and its defects with cancer mutants of TGFBR1/2 and SMAD2/3/4 (MSI targets), which neither the Hippo/RUNX3, TGFBR3, immunoglobulin diversification nor BER confusables contain.

qualifier: AMPA/kainate receptors and presynaptic membrane potential
name: AMPA/kainate transmission and presynaptic membrane potential regulation
rationale: Members cover AMPA and kainate receptor activation and clustering plus presynaptic depolarization, GIRK and Gbeta-gamma calcium-channel control, distinguishing them from NMDA, vesicle exocytosis and nicotinic receptor themes.

qualifier: capping, severing, bundling and ILK-PINCH-parvin adhesion
name: Actin filament capping, severing, bundling and ILK adhesion
rationale: Members regulate actin filament ends, severing, crosslinking and networks along with IPP-complex focal adhesion and integrin signaling, unlike confusables driven by Rho-family GTPase cycles and protrusion formation.

core: Planar cell polarity and convergent extension
qualifier: neural plate and axial midline morphogenesis
name: Planar polarity, convergent extension and neural plate/midline morphogenesis
rationale: Members link PCP/non-canonical Wnt and convergent extension to neural plate, notochord, floor plate and axial mesoderm formation, which the Wnt-calcium, Hedgehog and left-right confusables lack.

qualifier: alanine/oxaloacetate gluconeogenic substrates
name: Fructose catabolism and gluconeogenesis from alanine
rationale: Members cover fructose breakdown and its disorders together with alanine/oxaloacetate-fed gluconeogenesis, distinguishing them from glycerol/alditol and glucose-6-phosphatase/glucokinase confusables.

qualifier: anti-inflammatory and host-defense responses to protozoa
name: Macrophage anti-inflammatory and host defense against protozoa
rationale: Members are macrophage responses during protozoan (Leishmania) infection, such as ADORA2B/CD163/FCGR3A anti-inflammatory signaling, GBP defense and NADPH oxidase, unlike confusables on neutrophil respiratory burst or Mtb host manipulation.

qualifier: megakaryocyte lineage and RUNX1 transcriptional control
name: Myeloid, erythroid and megakaryocyte hematopoiesis with RUNX1 regulation
rationale: Members cover HSC maintenance and granulocyte, monocyte, erythroid and megakaryocyte differentiation driven by RUNX1 and CSF signaling, distinguishing them from lymphocyte development and interleukin/JAK-STAT confusables.

qualifier: transport and hydrolysis defects
name: Glucose-6-phosphate transport and hydrolysis deficiencies
rationale: All members concern ER glucose-6-phosphate transport (SLC37A4) or hydrolysis (G6PC, G6PC3) and their diseases, unlike glycogen synthesis/breakdown, glucokinase and fructose/gluconeogenesis confusables.

core: Hormonal control of glucose and glycogen metabolism
qualifier: insulin, glucagon and glucose-sensing signaling
name: Insulin, glucagon and glucose-sensing regulation of glucose metabolism
rationale: Members span insulin receptor/AKT2/GLUT4 signaling, glucagon-PKA, ChREBP glucose sensing and glycogen/gluconeogenesis control, whereas confusables focus on lipogenesis, insulin secretion or glycolytic fructose bisphosphate.

qualifier: PPAR, SREBP, LXR and ChREBP gene regulation
name: Adipogenesis and PPAR/SREBP/LXR control of lipid metabolism
rationale: Members cover white, brown and beige adipocyte differentiation and nuclear-receptor/SREBP/ChREBP transcriptional control of lipid and glucose metabolism, unlike glucagon-PKA signaling or thermogenesis confusables.

qualifier: 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase lipoylation and Fe-S cluster assembly
name: TCA cycle, 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase lipoylation and Fe-S assembly
rationale: Members cover TCA cycle reactions, lipoylated 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes (OGDH, OADH, DLD, glycine cleavage) and iron-sulfur cluster assembly, which the PDH regulation/CoA and vitamin B6 confusables lack.

qualifier: bone and dental tissues with FGF23-Klotho/PTH control
name: Bone and tooth mineralization and odontogenesis
rationale: Members regulate bone, dentin, enamel and cementum mineralization and tooth development with PTH and FGF-Klotho inputs, distinguishing them from phosphate transporter and osteoclast/bone resorption confusables.

qualifier: including telomere C-strand
name: Lagging-strand DNA replication including telomere C-strand synthesis
rationale: Members are primer synthesis, polymerase switching, flap removal and strand elongation at replication forks and the telomere C-strand, unlike repair synthesis in BER, NER or translesion synthesis confusables.

qualifier: HNF4/CDX-driven absorptive identity and crypt stem cells
name: Intestinal epithelial differentiation and HNF4/CDX absorptive identity
rationale: Members are dominated by intestinal crypt and enterocyte identity programmes driven by HNF4 and CDX factors, unlike confusables on endoderm specification, pancreatic development, lung epithelium or antimicrobial defense.

qualifier: hydrogen peroxide/oxidative stress and death receptor triggers
name: Regulation of oxidative stress- and death receptor-induced apoptosis
rationale: Members regulate intrinsic apoptosis triggered by hydrogen peroxide/oxidative stress and extrinsic death-receptor apoptosis (with or without ligand), unlike confusables on nitrosative stress, ferroptosis or general peroxide responses.

qualifier: bacterial attachment, entry and toxin uptake
name: Bacterial attachment, host cell entry and toxin uptake
rationale: Members center on bacterial adhesion and invasion of host cells (Listeria InlA, Gram-positive bacteria) and anthrax/diphtheria toxin uptake, whereas confusables concern Mtb intracellular manipulation and macrophage anti-inflammatory responses.

qualifier: initiation and ATR replication checkpoint
name: DNA replication initiation and replication-stress checkpoint
rationale: Members regulate cell-cycle DNA replication initiation and the ATR-mediated replication checkpoint, unlike confusables on generic cell-cycle signatures, pre-replicative complex assembly or break-induced replication.
